name: Kamino Komachi
source:
One of two upperclassmen enrolled in the art program. A sculptor, and a bit of a troublemaker. She cares deeply for her beloved underclassmen.

Likes: Tricks, souvenirs, her friends
Dislikes: Cold water, sweet things
